title: Primary garden area minimum area (Table 1.1b)
text: Primary garden area (applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C1.1.3 A single consolidated primary garden area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1b. Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions. Site area (m2) / Minimum primary garden area (m2 per dwelling): Greater than 220: 35; 191-220: 30; 161-190: 25; 131-160: 20; 100-130: 16. Site area rounded up to the nearest whole number. C1.1.4 Notwithstanding C1.1.3, for dwellings with a site area of 161m2 or greater, the required primary garden area in accordance with Table 1.1b may be reduced by 10m2, where a secondary ground level private open space is provided outside of the street setback area with: i. a minimum area of 10m2 and minimum dimension of 3m (refer Figure 1.1c) ii. uncovered and open to the sky (excluding minor projections); and iii. an additional small tree provided in addition to the minimum provisions of Table 1.2a.

exceptions.label: C1.1.4 secondary private open space on a site of 161 m2 or more: required PGA reduced by 10 m2

replaces.note: each site-area band reduced by 5 m2; 100-130 band 20 -> 16
C1.1.4 secondary POS reduction carried over (ch3-007)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Table 1.1b note 2 cites 'Figure 1.1b'; the PGA figure is labelled 1.1a (drafting error, no effect on values).

notes: diverges: coding R30-R80 and R80-equivalent codes (Chapter 3 p10 'applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only'; Chapter 2 starts at R50), so grouped R30-R40 carry the PGA where single houses use the OLA. Single consolidated PGA by site-area band (site area of the dwelling per A1, rounded up). C1.1.4 is an exception, not a rule. R100-SL is governed by C1.1.3-r100sl (Table 2.10a). Table 1.1b note 2 cites 'Figure 1.1b'; the PGA figure is labelled 1.1a.
